pages.title: The Stack
pages.summary: A street cat climbs a tower of stacked houses in a city that keeps growing upward.
pages.body:
# The Stack

The city of Hollowmere ran out of ground long ago, so it began building on itself. Every year a new house is hoisted onto the roofs of the old ones. The result is the Stack: a leaning tower of mismatched homes, hundreds of storeys tall, still growing.

You play [[wanderer|the Wanderer]], a street cat who lives where the sun never reaches. Each night the Stack creaks higher and the sky gets further away. The cat climbs to find where the building comes from.

## Tone
Cozy, melancholy and a little eerie. Warm window light against cold stone. Small, quiet moments between the climbs. The danger comes from the house itself, not from villains.

## Themes
- Growth without a plan: a place that only knows how to go up.
- Home as something stacked on top of other people's homes.
- Looking up versus looking down.

## Structure
Four zones, climbed in order, each more rooftop and less street:
1. [[the_underlane]]: the dark street level.
2. [[the_laundry_lofts]]: lines, sheets and chimneys.
3. [[the_belfry_terraces]]: old gardens and bell towers.
4. [[the_crown]]: the newest, unfinished top.

## Creatures
[[crawler|Crawlers]] and [[charger|Chargers]] are house-pests that have grown strange from living in the walls.

## Ending
At the Crown the cat finds the builders' hoist, which is hauled up by nothing at all: the Stack grows because everyone below keeps adding to it. The cat can't stop it, but it sits at the highest sill and sees the sky for the first time.

pages.title: Wanderer
pages.summary: A scruffy street cat who climbs the Stack to see the sky.
pages.body:
The Wanderer has no name because nobody in the Stack ever fed it long enough to give one. It sleeps in gutters in [[the_underlane]] and watches the lit windows far above.

The cat never speaks. It communicates in posture, tail and the occasional meow, and it reacts to the places it passes through, from the wary crouch in the dark to the slow blink at the very top in [[the_crown]].

It meets only hostile [[crawler|Crawlers]] and [[charger|Chargers]] on the way. See [[overview]].

fields.appearance: Small grey-and-ginger tabby with a torn left ear and a faded bell-less collar
fields.motivation: Curiosity. The cat has never seen the top of anything and wants to know where the light comes from.
fields.abilities: Quick, light, lands on its feet. Will gain climbing and leaping skills as the tower is climbed.

pages.title: Crawler
pages.summary: A slow wall-dwelling pest that patrols floors and ledges.
pages.body:
Crawlers live in the gaps between one house and the next. They feed on damp and old wallpaper paste. Their shells are made of plaster dust, so they look like part of the wall until they move.

They are the first thing the cat learns to avoid: predictable, slow, and a good lesson in timing jumps. See [[charger]] for their faster cousin.

fields.behavior: Patrols back and forth along a platform; turns at edges; harmless unless touched
fields.appearance: Pale, many-legged, the size of a loaf of bread, with a dusty shell of plaster flakes

pages.title: Charger
pages.summary: A stocky pest that spots the cat and rushes straight at it.
pages.body:
Chargers are rats that gnawed on so much old ironwork that their skulls have grown a brass crust. They hate the sound of bells and are drawn to movement.

Their rush punishes standing still, and the moment they stagger against a wall is the cat's chance to slip past. Slower relative [[crawler|Crawlers]] teach patience; Chargers teach dodging.

fields.behavior: Stands still until the cat is in line of sight, then charges in a straight line and crashes into walls, stunning itself briefly
fields.appearance: Squat, horned like a door knocker, with brass-coloured plating

pages.title: The Underlane
pages.summary: The dark street level beneath the Stack, where the cat begins.
pages.body:
The original street of Hollowmere, now roofed over by the weight of everything above it. Rain still drips down from nine hundred gutters.

The cat starts here. Climbing starts with drainpipes and window ledges, and the only way is up to [[the_laundry_lofts]].

fields.mood: Dim, damp, lonely, with distant warm light high above
fields.appearance: Cobbles, drainpipes, stacked crates, ground-floor doors bricked shut, a single lamp that never goes out

pages.title: The Laundry Lofts
pages.summary: Mid-tower storeys strung with washing lines, sheets and chimneys.
pages.body:
Residents here hang out their washing between houses, so the whole zone is a web of lines and sheets to leap across. Windows glow, radios murmur, nobody comes to the door.

It connects [[the_underlane]] below with [[the_belfry_terraces]] above.

fields.mood: Warm, busy, damp with steam; hints of people just out of sight
fields.appearance: Sagging clotheslines, billowing sheets, chimney stacks, pulleys and baskets

pages.title: The Belfry Terraces
pages.summary: Old rooftop gardens and bell towers high on the Stack.
pages.body:
These were the first roofs, grown over with gardens when the houses beneath them were new. The bells toll whenever the Stack shifts higher, and the sound drives [[charger|Chargers]] into a frenzy.

From the highest terrace a path leads up to [[the_crown]]; below lie [[the_laundry_lofts]].

fields.mood: Windswept, grand, a little sad; the bells ring on their own
fields.appearance: Overgrown terraces, cracked statues, bell towers, tiled roofs at steep angles

pages.title: The Crown
pages.summary: The unfinished top of the Stack, where the newest houses are hoisted into place.
pages.body:
The newest storeys are still skeletons of timber and rope. A great hoist swings houses up from below, though no one is working it.

The cat reaches the highest sill here and sees the sky. It is the end of the climb; see [[overview]] and [[the_belfry_terraces]].

fields.mood: Open, windy, awe, finally a sky
fields.appearance: Bare timber frames, scaffolding, hoist ropes, half-built roofs, stars overhead

items.name: Brass Hoist Key
items.description: It opens the way to The Crown.

modals.title: You got Second Leap
modals.body:
Jump again in mid-air.

It opens the way to The Laundry Lofts.

modals.title: You got Claw Cling
modals.body:
Slide down walls you press against, and jump off them. Climbs a single wall by jumping off and steering back.

It opens the way to The Belfry Terraces.

modals.title: You got Alley Dash
modals.body:
Dash key: a fast horizontal burst (one in the air until you land or touch a wall).

It opens the way to The Crown.

modals.title: You got Brass Hoist Key
modals.body: It opens the way to The Crown.

modals.title: The End
modals.body:
The unfinished top of the Stack, where the newest houses are hoisted into place.

Thanks for playing Untitled Game.

rooms.name: Culvert Mouth
rooms.notes: Start. A wet brick culvert under the city, dim lamps, gentle intro with a ledge or two.

rooms.name: Drip Gallery
rooms.notes: Low arched gallery with dripping pipes and broken planks over shallow pits.

rooms.name: Sump Shaft
rooms.notes: Vertical drain shaft with a dry ledge holding the save lamp.

rooms.name: Rat Run
rooms.notes: Long narrow tunnel; crawlers lurk. Leads to the guardian's chamber.

rooms.name: The Crawler's Cistern
rooms.notes: Wide round cistern. The guardian crawler holds the Second Leap; doors seal until it falls. Exit upward to the Lofts needs the double jump.

rooms.name: Drying Stairs
rooms.notes: Tall stairwell hung with damp sheets, first climb needing the double jump.

rooms.name: Washline Hall
rooms.notes: Wide loft strung with clotheslines and wooden platforms.

rooms.name: Mangle Room
rooms.notes: Rusted presses and rollers make cramped obstacles and hazards.

rooms.name: Linen Landing
rooms.notes: Hub landing with a save lamp. A high alcove (double jump) leads to the Claw Cling shrine.

rooms.name: Steam Chute
rooms.notes: Vertical chute venting steam and spikes.

rooms.name: Roofline Gap
rooms.notes: Smooth sheer wall rising to the roof; the way on to the Belfry needs Claw Cling.

rooms.name: Gutter Steps
rooms.notes: Rain-slick rooftop steps; the climb out of the Lofts onto open terraces.

rooms.name: Slate Terrace
rooms.notes: Wide windswept terrace of slate roofs and chimneys.

rooms.name: Weathervane Rise
rooms.notes: Tall climb up wall faces to the belfry bells.

rooms.name: Bell Landing
rooms.notes: Hub with a save lamp under a silent bell. Two wall-jump climbs lead to the Dash arena and the Hoist Key cache.

rooms.name: Rope Bridges
rooms.notes: Rope and plank bridges over a long drop.

rooms.name: Hoist Gate Court
rooms.notes: Courtyard before the sealed brass hoist up to the Crown; needs dash and hoist key.

rooms.name: Hoist Landing
rooms.notes: Arrival by brass hoist into a gilded antechamber; chargers patrol.

rooms.name: Gilded Hall
rooms.notes: Grand wide hall of cracked gold and columns.

rooms.name: Vestal Alcove
rooms.notes: Calm alcove with a save lamp before the finale.

rooms.name: Spire Stair
rooms.notes: Spiralling climb up the spire with spikes and chargers.

rooms.name: The Crown Terrace
rooms.notes: Open summit under the sky; the ending.

rooms.name: Claw Cling Shrine
rooms.notes: Quiet hidden shrine of scratched stone where the Claw Cling waits.

rooms.name: Alley Dash Arena
rooms.notes: Wide alley arena. The guardian charger holds the Alley Dash; doors seal until it falls.

rooms.name: Bellringer's Nook
rooms.notes: Cramped nook with the Brass Hoist Key on a hook.
